description: Read one workflow: its inputs (the keys run_workflow takes, marked when a run must be given them), outputs, state, and the full step graph when you are allowed to see it. Read this before running a workflow, and before editing one with update_workflow (pass the returned `updatetime` back as `loaded_updatetime`). Protected workflows from other creators show only their inputs, but they can still be run. Input lists and saved values hide the values of fields named like api_key, token, secret or password, and values that look like a provider key. Other saved values come back as saved: never repeat a key you see there.

include_graph.description: Include the step graph (contents). Set false for a short answer.

slug.description: The full workflow slug ("<name>-<5 character id>") or the workflow page URL.

name: get_workflow

notes.description: What the figure leaves out or counts only in part: steps charged after the run by usage or without a fixed price for their settings, steps counted as one unit of a per-unit price or at a default, and inputs that change the price.

required.description: Whether a run must be given this input, as far as Wiro says. Left out when that is not known.

runCount.description: Runs while the workflow was in the public gallery, by anyone. Left out when there are none; the owner's runs of a private workflow are in list_workflow_runs.

title: Get a Wiro workflow
